rationale: For an agriculture and farming e-commerce platform, the user needs to feel grounded, secure, and connected to nature. The 'Organic & Earthy' archetype maps perfectly, utilizing deep forest greens, warm sand base colors, and amber accents to communicate both natural growth and professional reliability.

background.description: Warm off-white sand base to avoid clinical starkness and emulate a natural environment.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green. Used sparingly for main branding, primary navigation, and high-level structure.

accent.description: Earthy Amber/Ochre. High visibility accent used for critical conversion actions like 'Add to Cart' and 'Checkout'.

headings.description: Rugged, structural sans-serif that balances modern e-commerce with industrial reliability.

body.description: Clean, highly legible humanist sans-serif. Perfect for detailed agricultural product specs and reading.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing / E1 The Tetris Grid

cards.classes: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1

components.marketing_sections: Pure HTML/Tailwind for bento grids, hero sections, and category showcases.
components.interactive_elements: Shadcn UI customized (Forms, Dialogs, Select, Dropdowns).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Checkbox. Replace raw HTML inputs.

buttons.primary: bg-[#14532D] text-white hover:bg-[#166534] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#D97706] text-white hover:bg-[#B45309] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold text-lg transition-colors shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl
buttons.outline: border-2 border-stone-200 text-[#1C1917] hover:border-[#14532D] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

animations.scrolling: lenis smooth scrolling for premium feel
animations.microinteractions: Subtle translate-y on cards, button press scale down.

media.rules: No pure black overlays on images. Let images breathe. Product imagery must be crisp.

hero_tractor.description: Green tractor parked outdoors. Use for main e-commerce hero banner background with gradient overlay.

hero_topographic_bg.description: Abstract topographic map pattern. Perfect for subtle background textures on feature sections or the checkout page.

category_seeds.description: Person holding handful of seeds. Use for the Seeds product category card.

category_tools.description: Farming tools (shovels/forks) laying on ground. Use for the Farm Tools product category card.

category_sprayers.description: High-tech 3D render of an agriculture drone sprayer. Use for the Sprayers/Tech product category card.

category_machinery.description: Tractor with large sprayer attachment in a field. Use for Machinery product category card.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='category-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install requested font families: Outfit and Manrope.
Construct the e-commerce home page using the bento grid methodology detailed above. Provide high-quality visual asymmetry.
Implement product filtering and catalog layout with generous spacing and distinct separation. Avoid cramped grid displays.
Ensure 'Add to Cart' buttons use the Accent color (#D97706) for high contrast and conversion optimization.
Add the subtle topographic background texture image behind key sections (like the 'About us' or 'Value Props') to enrich the visual depth.
Use standard HTML inputs mixed with Shadcn components, prioritizing Shadcn for all complex UI like modals, dropdowns, and date pickers.
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for foundational marketing page layout structures (bento grids, cards).
Integrate the placeholder urls EXACTLY as formatted.
